scope: Article #2115 at bounded systems and timescales; claims and revision conditions, not final conclusions

claims.claim: Accounts of consciousness should face explicit shared measurements, rival comparisons and specified support-loss conditions.
claims.discriminating_test: Blind independent teams to source labels, compare predeclared error detection, correction and out-of-sample performance with equal resources.
claims.loss_condition: If a simpler equally resourced method performs as well or better on preregistered valid correction measures, remove any alleged special RCF advantage.

claims.claim: Some bounded, differentiated, temporally sustained organization may constitute a perspectival conscious occurrence.
claims.discriminating_test: Match reporting and task performance across perturbations changing predicted closure properties; independently calibrate awareness, pathology and confounds.
claims.loss_condition: Stable, independently calibrated experiential evidence without predicted organization or matched organization with divergent experiential evidence reduces constitutive support; do not claim decisive status for unvalidated markers.

claims.claim: A proposed physical interaction has implementational thermodynamic costs and boundary-dependent energy/information accounting; this does not imply that each distinction dissipates kT ln 2.
claims.discriminating_test: Specify physical transition, logical erasure/reversibility, temperature, units, work/heat channels, measurement boundary and control for implementation-specific costs.
claims.loss_condition: Remove a particular Landauer lower-bound inference if the operation is reversible, unmeasured, incorrectly typed or violates the necessary premises.

claims.claim: Organizational closure/constraint regeneration can be measured and may predict selected agency, viability and cognitive capacities.
claims.discriminating_test: Independent intervention on closure mechanisms with energy-flow controls, viability measurements, held-out transfer tasks and matched simpler baselines.
claims.loss_condition: If closure-specific variables fail to improve prediction or causal control over simpler measured mechanisms, compress or drop their special explanatory claim.

claims.claim: Kleiner–Hoel independence and strict-dependence results constrain theory-testing under their respective quantifiers; a lenient middle relation requires physical demonstration.
claims.discriminating_test: Define the physically realizable substitution space, inference/prediction observables and exact Definition 3.8/Appendix A quantifiers; attempt finite and constructive countermodels.
claims.loss_condition: Any universal recovery claim fails if a physically plausible substitution still meets the original theorem premises or if no validated lenient relation is exhibited.

claims.claim: Behavior, report, perturbational complexity and clinical scales offer fallible evidence at stated scopes, not individually infallible phenomenal meters.
claims.discriminating_test: Test convergent/discrepant measures under no-report paradigms, anesthesia, disorders of consciousness and negative controls; separately validate construct sensitivity and specificity.
claims.loss_condition: Revise any marker's confidence if independent dissociations, confounds or failed transport across patient classes show it lacks a claimed necessary or sufficient link.

publication_warning: Formal satisfiability, citation identity, theory compatibility and an observed clinical correlate each have distinct evidential scope. No automatic promotion across these bridges.
